batting.sample: At least 20 pressure balls faced across at least 2 pressure matches.
batting.firstInnings: 35% wickets lost + 30% innings progress + 35% score deficit versus the format-season first-innings par.
batting.chase: 45% required-run-rate difficulty + 30% wickets lost + 25% innings progress.
batting.score: 40% pressure strike-rate percentile + 20% boundary-rate percentile + 20% inverse dot-ball-rate percentile + 20% pressure runs per pressure match percentile.
batting.confidence: Score is shrunk toward 50 using pressure balls / (pressure balls + 40).
batting.overall: For the overall batter Top 10, pressure runs, balls, boundaries and dots are aggregated across batting positions. Pressure-match count uses the maximum position-specific count to reduce overlap double-counting; role-specific leaderboards are more appropriate when a player's batting role matters.

bowling.sample: At least 48 pressure legal balls across at least 5 pressure matches, plus at least 60 non-pressure legal balls.
bowling.firstInnings: 45% innings progress + 30% wickets in hand + 25% current scoring-rate pressure relative to the format-season average. Current-rate pressure is scaled from 0.5× to 1.5× the average rate and clipped to 0–100.
bowling.chase: 40% innings progress + 35% wickets in hand + 25% chase-live factor. The chase-live factor scales required run rate relative to the format-season average from 0.8× to 2.0× and is clipped to 0–100.
bowling.score: 30% inverse pressure economy percentile + 20% wickets per six legal balls percentile + 15% dot-ball percentile + 10% inverse boundary-concession percentile + 15% economy-retention percentile + 10% wicket-rate-retention percentile.
bowling.confidence: Score is shrunk toward 50 using pressure legal balls / (pressure legal balls + 48).

methodology.scope: IPL seasons 2022–2026 and men's T20 Internationals from 2022 onward. Other T20 competitions, including Men's T20 Emerging Teams Asia Cup and Asia Cup Rising Stars, are excluded.
methodology.innings: Only innings 1 and 2 are included; extra innings / Super Overs are excluded.
methodology.availability: All players in the 10 user-supplied current franchise squad lists are excluded. Retired players and Pakistan-associated IDs inferred from T20I team mappings are also excluded. The Pakistan mapping is a proxy, not a definitive nationality register. Official auction registration, NOCs and individual opt-outs are not present in the supplied files.
